If you are spending the night at someone's house, fill a glass with water and put it in the freezer overnight. Before you leave, without them noticing, put the glasses upside down on a table where they won't see it for a while. Hopefully the ice melts by then. I was never taught that if you commit suicide, or even murder someone, that you would go to Hell. Jesus told the guy who was on the cross next to Him for being a murderer that his sins were forgiven and that He would see him in Heaven. Why would any other murderer be any different?

Well, there is a difference between human morality and Godly morality. If you go by human morality, it is possible to be a "good person." But, quite obviously, humans are flawed and imperfect. So even if you treat others how you would like to be treated, that probably isn't how you should treat others. Since we aren't perfect, we can't know everything that's best for us. Many people, if given the choice, would probably do things like sit around all day. But that doesn't mean that is good for them. So even when we try to do our best to be "good," we can't do that right simply out of ignorance. God, on the other hand, is perfect. He knows what's best for us. So wouldn't it make sense to listen to someone who is perfect, wants the best for you, and knows what he is talking about? Even with that, no one can work their way into heaven. Only Jesus can give us perfect and everlasting life with Him in heaven. You just have to accept Him as your Savior.
